# Anurag Nepal

> Anurag Nepal is a freelance Java and Spring Boot backend developer based in Kathmandu, Nepal. He builds secure, scalable REST APIs, microservices and AI features for startups and businesses, and is available for freelance projects worldwide.

- Website: https://anuragnepal.com.np/
- Email: anuragnepal2062@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Anurag-Nepal
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/anurag-nepal/

## Services

- Backend and REST API development with Java and Spring Boot
- Authentication and payment integration (Spring Security, JWT, email OTP, PayPal)
- Microservices and event driven systems (Spring Cloud, Apache Kafka, Keycloak, Redis)
- Messaging infrastructure and high performance networking (Netty, custom message brokers)
- AI and LLM feature integration (Spring AI, Ollama, local LLMs)

## Tech stack

Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Cloud, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Spring AI, Apache Kafka, Netty, Keycloak, Redis, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Docker, microservices, REST APIs, JWT authentication.

## Projects

- [EverestMQ](https://github.com/Anurag-Nepal/EverestMQ): Message broker built from scratch in Java and Netty with a custom binary protocol, append only topic logs, crash recovery, long polling consumers and configurable acknowledgment policies.
- [Event-Driven Microservices](https://github.com/Anurag-Nepal/Event-Driven-Microservices-with-Spring-Cloud-Gateway-and-Kafka): Microservices platform with Spring Cloud Gateway, Eureka, Keycloak OAuth2 and JWT, Redis rate limiting, Resilience4J circuit breakers and Kafka based asynchronous job processing.
- [DishGenie](https://github.com/Anurag-Nepal/DishGenie-AI-receipe-Generator): AI recipe generator API built with Spring Boot and Spring AI, running Llama 2 locally in an Ollama Docker container.

## Blog

- [Spring Boot JWT Authentication with Email OTP](https://anuragnepal.com.np/blog/spring-boot-jwt-authentication-email-otp/): Step by step JWT authentication in Spring Boot 3 with Spring Security 6, jjwt and email OTP verification.
- [Local LLM in Spring Boot with Spring AI and Ollama](https://anuragnepal.com.np/blog/spring-ai-ollama-local-llm-docker/): Run an LLM locally with Ollama in Docker and call it from Spring Boot using Spring AI ChatClient.
